headline: Crypto TVL, DEX volumes and stablecoin data: 3 November 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL at $43.6bn followed by Base at $5.89bn and Solana at $5.39bn. Uniswap V4 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $982m while Tether generated the top fees at $16.8m. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoin supply with several smaller pegged assets showing deviations. Multiple security incidents occurred in the prior fortnight including a $6.36bn Binance event.
